title: PostReady: PR #529 — Mobile P1: thumb-zone action bars, preamble compression, loading discipline
description: Implemented Mobile P1 audit improvements: fixed thumb-zone action bars for Create and pack pages on phones, compressed preamble text to desktop-only, and tightened loading discipline across five live mobile screens.

title: PostReady: PR #530 — Mobile P2+P3: labeled card actions, honest tab labels, tighter copy
description: Continued mobile polish: labeled card action buttons for clarity, relabeled tabs to be honest about their scope, and tightened copy throughout the mobile experience.

title: PostReady: PR #531 — Create tabs: hint rows → pill chips; unlimited banners removed
description: Replaced hint-row banners on Create tabs with compact pill chips and removed unlimited-plan banners, reducing visual noise and tightening the Create page header.

title: PostReady: PR #532 — Batch: two-column workspace (queue left, sticky run panel right)
description: Redesigned the Batch page with a two-column layout: post queue on the left, sticky run panel fixed on the right for always-visible controls.

title: PostReady: PR #533 — Create Video: two-column workspace (form left, sticky delivery right)
description: Redesigned Create Video with a two-column layout: creative form on the left, sticky delivery panel locked on the right for a cleaner, always-accessible UX.

title: PostReady: PR #534 — Create Post: two-column workspace (brief left, result right)
description: Redesigned Create Post with a two-column layout: post brief on the left, generated result on the right — matching the two-column pattern across Batch and Video pages.

title: PostReady: PR #535 — Fix: Quick/Extended duration pills overflow in video delivery panel
description: Fixed Quick/Extended duration pill buttons overflowing the video delivery panel on smaller viewports.

title: PostReady: PR #536 — Fix: destination picker → uniform two-column grid
description: Fixed the destination picker layout to render a consistent uniform two-column grid across all viewport sizes.

title: PostReady: PR #537 — Video: replace destination picker with two-tile shape control
description: Replaced the destination picker on the video page with a cleaner two-tile shape control for selecting video format/aspect ratio.

title: PostReady: PR #538 — Derive video shape from connected accounts
description: Video shape (aspect ratio) now derives automatically from connected social accounts, removing manual selection and defaulting to the correct format for each destination.
